emotional_tone: Objective, authoritative, spacious, and highly legible. It feels like a high-end European meteorology tool.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter text-slate-900 leading-none
hierarchy.data_value: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-medium font-mono text-slate-900 tracking-tight

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono specifically for coordinates, timestamps, metrics (temperature, CAPE), and map overlays.
Headlines must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).

layout_and_spacing.structure: Asymmetric Dashboard. Left Sidebar (Data) + Right Main Area (Map).

grid_system.container: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 h-screen w-full overflow-hidden
grid_system.sidebar: col-span-1 lg:col-span-4 h-full overflow-y-auto bg-white border-r border-slate-200 shadow-[4px_0_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] z-10 relative

layout_and_spacing.widget_surface: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none shadow-none. Brutalist/Swiss clean lines. No heavy dropshadows, rely on 1px borders.

map.tile_layer: Use CartoDB Positron (Light) tiles for a stark, high-contrast base so colored lightning strikes pop out.
map.radius_circle: 20km radius centered on Lourdes (Lat: 43.0915, Lng: -0.0457). Stroke: 2px dashed #0F172A, Fill: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05).
map.markers: Lightning strikes represented by #DC2626 dots with an absolute positioned ping animation layer.

alert_banner.style: Glassmorphism sticky header inside sidebar. backdrop-blur-xl bg-red-600/10 border-b border-red-600/20. Text is dark red.
alert_banner.typography: IBM Plex Mono for the timestamp and Cabinet Grotesk for the alert message.

history_chart.style: Minimalist line chart or bar chart representing strikes over 24h. No grid lines, minimal axes. Color: #0F172A. Tooltips must use strict square corners and Mono font.

cape_gauge.style: A custom linear gradient bar (Yellow to Red) with a sharp black indicator tick mark representing Convective Available Potential Energy.

current_conditions.layout: 2x2 Bento grid within the sidebar. Each cell has a 1px border. Values in bold Mono font.

motion_and_interaction.live_indicators: Any live data point (e.g., 'EN DIRECT') must feature a tiny pulsing dot (bg-red-500 animate-pulse).
motion_and_interaction.lightning_strikes: Map markers must use CSS `animate-ping` for a ripple effect when appearing.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons and list items darken background slightly (hover:bg-slate-50). Border colors shift from slate-200 to slate-400.

image_urls.description: Minimalist cloud texture used for the top branding section of the sidebar, applying low opacity to maintain high contrast with text overlay.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against the map or colored banners meets APCA guidelines.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons (login, save favorite, map controls) MUST include `data-testid` attributes with kebab-case, role-based names (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind for the structural layout (grid-cols-12).
Use standard Shadcn components for forms/dialogs (JWT login) if needed, but strip rounding (rounded-none) to match the Swiss/Editorial aesthetic.

Install the required fonts via Google Fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local webfont setup if available, otherwise use a high-end alternative like Outfit for headings if Cabinet Grotesk fails), Outfit, and IBM Plex Mono.
Implement react-leaflet for the map. Use standard Leaflet CSS.
All text must be in French as per the problem statement.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all actionable UI elements.
